task: EXP-M4-13 R4 CASCADE-ROOT RESOLUTION for byte0 roots 0x00/0x54/0x40/0x42/0x21/0x24. For each root: decide GENUINE leader vs cascade debris (mid-instruction landing after an upstream mis-length); close genuine ops by byte-diff; for cascade, name the upstream owner. Clean-room: OWN-MSL only (shdump compile-only, no GPU dispatch); reproduced byte-exact.
kind_detail: 2 length-rule EDITS that fix upstream mis-lengths (0x40 + 0x54 roots are cascade), 1 length-rule ADD for a genuine op (0x00 root), and 2 NEW descriptors that name the now-lengthed bytes. 0x42/0x21/0x24 are pure cascade owned by other families (reported, not fixed here -- they clear when those owners close).

0x40.owner: low-nibble-b VERTEX output-position op `Xb 00 26 00 40 00 00 SS` (was mis-lengthed 4 by the nb_ray `b2 hi-nibble 2 -> 4` compact-move rule; is actually 8).
0x40.evidence: corpus co-occurrence 55/55: every `Xb 00 26 00` is followed by `40 00 00 SS` (SS in {04,08,0c,10,14}); `40 00 00 SS` appears as an independent leader in only 2/57 sites. So `40 00 00 SS` is this op's operand tail (+4..+7), NOT a leader.
0x40.impact: first-desyncs on 0x40: 31 -> 17. Fully closed the depth_*/half_frag/rt_frag_query/vertex_stagein vertex preambles.
0x40.residual: half_vec2 `40 87 26 83 00 85` is a GENUINE 6-byte LOW-half float ALU (byte+2=0x26 coord op-select; the low-nibble-0 sibling of the n8 low-nibble-8 high-half op h_coord_hi_ext, length 6+2*(byte+4&3)). Left UNRESOLVED here (belongs to a low-nibble-0 half-ALU family task; a byte0==0x40-only rule would be an over-narrow slice of a 16-dst-reg family and byte0 0x30/0x60/0x90/0xb0 collide with sampler/spill rules). `40 a0 57 ..` (x8, vertex_stagein) and `40 81 af ..`(bf16 cvt_f2h tail) are further small cascades.

0x00.verdict: GENUINE op closed + remaining are diverse cascade
0x00.genuine: `00 YY 40 SS` (byte0==0x00, byte+1 in {0x04,0x0a,0x0c}, byte+2==0x40) is a genuine 4-byte VERTEX varying-output SLOT op emitted immediately before each `57 SS 54 ..` vary_store (byte+3 SS tracks the store slot). Reproduced byte-exact (own-MSL vtest_posonly @60 `00 0c 40 60` -> vary_store). Genuine leader: appears after 8+ distinct preceding ops corpus-wide (276 occurrences), so not a tail.
0x00.remaining_cascade: `00 04 00 00` (x13, frag_output vertex) = interior of the vertex 0x17 coordinate-transform bundle (same owner as the 0x21 root); `00 02 e7 ..`/`00 08 e7 ..` (half2 saturate/neg, tail before device_store); `00 10 11 00` (f16 subgroup epilogue before stop); `00 02 80 ..`, `00 0e 0f ..` etc. -- all cascade owned by the immediately preceding op's family. UNRESOLVED (belong to vertex-coord / half2 / f16 owners).

0x54.verdict: CASCADE (fixed the dominant epilogue) + shift-tails reported
0x54.owner: low-nibble-2 register-operand cmpsel that produces the final result and is immediately followed by the program-epilogue device_store. The `(ln in {7,f} or b2==0x25) -> 10` branch over-read it by 2, swallowing the store's `e7 00`/`67 00` head and orphaning its `54 00 00 0X 21 00` tail (before the trailing cvt_f2h + stop) as the spurious 0x54 root.
0x54.evidence: 8 + 14-byte device_store + 4-byte stop tiles the tail exactly (abs_s32@28 `02 01 0f 80 81 04 07 02` then `e7 00 54 ..`; uniform_branch@56). 24 corpus sites, all with a store head at the 10-byte position; no genuine 10B cmpsel has `e7/67 00` at bytes +8..+9. Fix gated on that store head.
0x54.remaining_cascade: `54 XX 03 XX` (byte+2==0x03) x~9 = operand tail of a mis-lengthed 0x27/0xa7 shift/convert op (the shift-op byte+2==0x54 marker leaks a `54 .. 03` tail); owner = the low-nibble-7 convert/shift family (0x27/0xa7), consistent with round-2 n7_fence. UNRESOLVED.

0x42.owner: dec2_n8 RAY intersection-query GETTER result-marshalling sequence (`mov_imm(Xc 80) + 42 00 00 00 .. + reg_move(fb 00 00 00) + rt_transform_test`). byte+2==0x00 (never a real low-nibble-2 op-select), so `42 XX 00 00 00 00` is a marshalling operand word, NOT a genuine low-nibble-2 op.
0x42.evidence: 26/32 of the 0x42 first-desyncs are in dec2_n8__g_*/s_* getter kernels, between rt_ray_mem/rt_as_load and rt_transform_test. Owner = the n8/nb RT-getter family; 0x42 clears when the intersection-query getter marshalling is characterized. UNRESOLVED.
0x42.impact: unchanged (32) -- out of scope of a 0x42-leader fix; correctly NOT force-sliced.

0x21.owner: (a) VERTEX 0x17 coordinate-transform bundle: `17 22 a2 b0 ..` is mis-lengthed by the compute simd_ballot `0x17 -> 10` rule in vertex context, orphaning the `21 82 a6 b0 07 02 82 01` coord continuation (17/29 sites, all frag_output/derivatives __vertex). (b) transcendental low-nibble-2 op tail `21 0c 02 00`/`21 1a 02 00` after an n2_op6 (7 sites). (c) `21 00 XX 00` epilogue operand (few).
0x21.evidence: the `a2 b0`/`a6 b0` operand structure repeats across the 0x17-led vertex bundle; reproduced in own-MSL vtest_posonly @10-@28. Genuine vertex-coord op lengths are a separate family (not one of the 6 roots). UNRESOLVED (vertex-coord + transcendental owners).

0x24.owner: (a) MESH-stage 0x04 op: the fragment-only `b0==0x04 && b1!=0xea -> 8` centroid-read rule misfires in mesh shaders, over-reading a mesh 0x04 op and swallowing the following `0f 06` reconverge; the exposed `24 01 00 00` is that reconverge's operand tail (7/12 sites, all mesh). (b) sin/cos range-reduction `24 83 82 08` tail (3 sites). (c) frag_discard vary_store tail / r11g11b10f ibfe tail (1 each).
0x24.evidence: mesh_line@50 `04 83 00 10 00 00` should be 6B, then `0f 06 24 01 00 00` (6B reconverge) tiles to the get_sr at 62. Owner = mesh 0x04 family + the mis-scoped fragment 0x04 rule. UNRESOLVED (mesh-stage op family + sin/cos).

descriptors.semantics: Vertex-stage output-position / attribute op. byte0 high nibble = dst reg; byte+7 = varying/output slot (0x04/0x08/0x0c/0x10/0x14). Bytes +4..+7 (`40 00 00 SS`) were the dominant spurious 0x40 root desync before this op was lengthed 8.
descriptors.provenance: byte-diff EXP-M4-13 R4 (own-MSL): `Xb 00 26 00 40 00 00 SS`; corpus co-occurrence 55/55 with a preceding low-nibble-b leader; `40 00 00 SS` independent in only 2/57 sites.

descriptors.semantics: Vertex varying-output SLOT descriptor emitted immediately before each `57 SS 54 ..` vary_store; byte+3 = the varying slot (monotone, tracks the store slot). byte+1 (sel) in {0x04,0x0a,0x0c} = the output-class form.

notes: Round-2 verify's hypothesis is CONFIRMED for the two biggest roots (0x40, 0x54) and the residue of the others: these landings are overwhelmingly mid-instruction debris after an upstream mis-length, not real ops. 0x40 = tail of an 8-byte low-nibble-b vertex op; 0x54 = the 2-byte over-read of a store-epilogue cmpsel; 0x42 = RT-getter marshalling; 0x21 = vertex 0x17 coord bundle + transcendental n2 tails; 0x24 = mesh 0x04 misfire + sin/cos. The ONE genuine NEW leader among the six roots is 0x00's `00 YY 40 SS` vary_slot (and, as a residual, half_vec2's low-half float `40 87 26 83`). No length gate was broadened in a way that mis-slices a real op: each edit is signature-gated and shown to be 0-regression.
